Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:74174: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: linux/dim: Fix divide by 0 in RDMA DIM (CVE-2022-49670)

* kernel: wifi: mt76: mt7925: fix off by one in mt7925_load_clc() (CVE-2024-57990)

* kernel: xfrm: hold dev ref until after transport_finish NF_HOOK (CVE-2026-31663)

* kernel: crypto: pcrypt - Fix handling of MAY_BACKLOG requests (CVE-2026-43493)

* kernel: sctp: purge outqueue on stale COOKIE-ECHO handling (CVE-2026-52924)

* kernel: net: pull headers in qdisc_pkt_len_segs_init() (CVE-2026-53091)

* kernel: netfilter: conntrack: remove sprintf usage (CVE-2026-53002)

* kernel: tipc: fix double-free in tipc_buf_append() (CVE-2026-52993)

* kernel: xfrm: policy: fix use-after-free on inexact bin in xfrm_policy_bysel_ctx() (CVE-2026-53239)

* kernel: ip6: vti: Use ip6_tnl.net in vti6_siocdevprivate() (CVE-2026-63921)

* kernel: xfrm: input: hold netns during deferred transport reinjection (CVE-2026-63919)

* kernel: ip6: vti: Use ip6_tnl.net in vti6_changelink() (CVE-2026-63917)

* kernel: AMD-SN-7061: Safe RET Interrupt Vulnerability (CVE-2026-68480)

* kernel: s390/pkey: Check length in pkey_pckmo handler implementation (CVE-2026-64558)

* kernel: net: qrtr: restrict socket creation to the initial network namespace (CVE-2026-68294)

* kernel: xfrm: fix stale skb->prev after async crypto steals a GSO segment (CVE-2026-68426)

* kernel: dm-verity: fix buffer overflow in FEC calculation (CVE-2026-72098)

* kernel: netfilter: flowtable: publish GC-visible tuple last (CVE-2026-74746)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Intel CWF: CPU is unable to obtain cstate1 on idle system [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-223903)

* RT scheduler livelock: migrate-disabled task at pushable-list head causes repeated RT push/stopper retries, starving a critical RT task (remaining issue after CVE-2026-45919 fix in 94894c9c477e) (JIRA:RHEL-250639)

* DPLL: Add support for pin operational state [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-262441)

* try_charge_memcg() refactor in kernel 5.14.0-687.36.1 causes premature memcg OOM with GiB of clean page cache present [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-269059)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
